messages.topic: Resolved OAUTH_INVALID_RESPONSE Error via RFC 9207 Discord Provider Issuer Configuration
messages.message: Completely resolved the underlying OAuth2 sign-in error on veplexity.dev: Diagnostic error capturing pinpointed OAUTH_INVALID_RESPONSE with expected: https://authjs.dev. Tracing oauth4webapi confirmed Discord adheres to RFC 9207 (Authorization Server Issuer Identification) and returns iss=https://discord.com in callback parameters. Because NextAuth v5's default Discord provider lacked an explicit issuer definition, the validator compared incoming iss (https://discord.com) against fallback issuer (https://authjs.dev) and aborted. Explicitly setting issuer: 'https://discord.com' in auth.ts satisfies the RFC 9207 comparison. Tested and verified in Node with 100% pass rate. Committed (003b971) and deployed to production.
messages.status: In Sync - OAuth Root Cause Resolved & Production Deployed
